PDO/MySQL</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; mbstring</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; mcrypt</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; mhash</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; simplexml</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; curl</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; gd2, ImageMagick 6.3.7 (or later) or both</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; soap</li>\n\t\t</ul>\n\t</li>\n\t<li>\t\t<a href=\"https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.6/en/installing.html\">MySQL 5.6.x</a></li>\n\t<li>\t\tMail Transfer Agent (MTA) or an SMTP server</li>\n\t<li>\t\tOptional but recommended:\n\t\t<ul>\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <a href=\"https://xdebug.org/download.php\">php_xdebug2.2.0</a> or later (development environments only; can have an adverse effect on performance)</li>\n\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; PHPUnit (as a command-line tool) 4.1 or later</li>\n\t\t</ul>\n\t</li>\n</ol>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/requisite_zps2xvcvzhw.png\" style=\"width: 830px; height: 347px;\"></p>\n<p>\tI&rsquo;m not going to list them here. In the future if they change, please check the <a href=\"http://devdocs.magento.com/guides/v2.0/install-gde/bk-install-guide.html#install-verify-prereq\" target=\"_blank\">Magento 2 documentation</a> for those prerequisites</p>\n"},{"title": "Composer and magento2","id": "composer_and_magento2","content": "<h2>\n\tInstall composer</h2>\n<p>\tYou can use Composer to install Magento 2. It is a tool for dependent management in PHP which allows you to declare the dependent libraries your project needs and install them for you. Composer enables you to manage Magento 2, extensions, and their dependencies.<br>\n\t<br>\n\tHere are the key advantages for using Composer:</p>\n<ol>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Easy to integrate third-party components into the code base</li>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Component-based architecture with robust dependency management</li>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Reduce extension conflicts and compatibility issues</li>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Versioned dependencies, semantic versioning</li>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Supports PHP Framework Interoperability standards</li>\n\t<li>\t\t&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; An alternative to Pear packaging system</li>\n</ol>\n<p>\t<br>\n\tNow, <a href=\"https://getcomposer.org/download/\">download Composer</a> and run its latest version. For more details on further configuration when installing composer, please visit this Composer installation documentation.<br>\n\tFollow the 6 steps below to start Composer installation<br>\n\t<br>\n\tInstall Composer via this link: <a href=\"https://getcomposer.org/download/\">https://getcomposer.org/download/</a></p>\n<p>\tDownload and run <strong>Composer-Setup.exe</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://www.venustheme.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/11.jpg\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong>Click on<strong> NEXT </strong>to continue</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://www.venustheme.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/2.-magento2.jpg\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Select the path where <strong>php.exe</strong> is located with xampp: <strong>C:/xampp/php/php.exe</strong> and then click on N<strong>EXT</strong></strong></p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://www.venustheme.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/4.-magento2.0.png\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\tChoose<strong> Install</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://www.venustheme.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/5.-magento2.jpg\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong><strong>Finish:</strong> If you see the window is the same as the following one, you installed Composer successfully.</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://www.venustheme.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/8.-magento2.jpg\"></strong></p>\n<p>\tView more this <a href=\"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xD6KvV_cEQI\">video</a> .</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tInstall Componser to magento2</h2>\n<p>\tGet Magento 2.0 code from GitHub repository: <a href=\"https://github.com/magento/magento2\">https://github.com/magento/magento2</a></p>\n<p>\tCopy the source code to htdocs folder of localhost</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" display as below. You will have to wait for a while and Theme install composer is completed.</strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\tUpdate package:</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/Ves-superstore2/image_103.jpg\" style=\"width: 850px; height: 913px;\"></p>\n<p>\tThe cmd screen will display as below. You will have to wait for a while</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Quickstart Installation","id": "quickstart_installation","content": "<p>\tQuickstart package is to minimize time and effort in installing the theme as per Demo site. Kindly note that, with Quickstart, all your existing data will be overwritten.</p>\n<p>\tThus, we recommend using Quickstart for your first installation or just in case you want to refresh your site to the very beginning.</p>\n<h2>\n\tStep1: Decompress quickstart pakage into webroot folder</h2>\n<p>\t( The quickstart is file &quot;theme_name_quickstart.zip&quot; in the file which you downloaded.)</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/Ves-superstore2/quickstart_package.jpg\" style=\"width: 793px; height: 609px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Setp2: </strong>Create new database and import database sql file<strong> database.sql</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i1022.photobucket.com/albums/af350/thonglm122/Ves%20iShop/3-19-2016%2012-03-17%20PM_zpsgfzf5lzo.jpg\" style=\"width: 790px; height: 473px;\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tStep3: Import database</h2>\n<p>\t( Decompress the file &quot;theme_name.zip&quot; we will get the file &quot;sql/database.sql&quot;, import the file into database which you created before )</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/Ves-superstore2/import_database_2.jpg\" style=\"width: 760px; height: 491px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\tTo import database file, you should go to phpmyadmin of your site &gt; click on your database which you created before &gt; click on top bar button &quot;Import&quot;.<br>\n\tBrowse the database.sql in the folder sql above, then run import sql file</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/raLe94r.png\" style=\"width: 1465px; height: 923px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tStep4: Install theme</h2>\n<p>\tThen, open browser and go to: <strong>http://localhost/ves_fasony </strong>to start to install theme</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\t&nbsp;</h2>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/1_zpsydxzrfmz.png\"></p>\n<p>\t<strong>Installation Run:</strong><br>\n\t<br>\n\tFollow these below steps to run Installation process</p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Choose Start Readiness Check. After Start Readiness Check is completed, select Next</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/2_zps6fjufywi.png\" style=\"width: 992px; height: 474px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; you need to click on &rdquo; Start Readiness Check&rdquo; first, &nbsp;then it will be like the below image</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/3_zpsmt5svizr.png\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Enter server and database in step 2 and then click on Next</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i1022.photobucket.com/albums/af350/thonglm122/Ves%20iShop/3-19-2016%2001-48-13%20PM_zpsixl8uucp.jpg\" style=\"width: 985px; height: 549px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Put your website link and continue to click on Next</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i1022.photobucket.com/albums/af350/thonglm122/Ves%20iShop/3-19-2016%2001-49-06%20PM_zpsbwdnhmm9.jpg\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Customize your store: you can choose time Zone, Currency and Languages</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/6_zpsqhazv21q.png\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; You need to Create Admin Account. Enter your information and move to the next step</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i1022.photobucket.com/albums/af350/thonglm122/Ves%20Alesia/3-20-2016%2011-34-43%20AM_zpswxwjoytq.jpg\" style=\"width: 968px; height: 533px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; In this step, you should click on the button: Install Now</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/8_zpsarsauklo.png\"></p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; It will take some minutes to complete this installation process. If your window is the same as below, CONGRAT! You install Ves Alesia theme successfully</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i1022.photobucket.com/albums/af350/thonglm122/Ves%20Alesia/3-20-2016%2011-43-05%20AM_zpsyqnrrzny.jpg\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Manual Installation","id": "manual_installation","content": "<p>\t<strong>Step1: </strong>Upload and decompress into webroot folder (which you setup magento 2 before) the file themes.zip in the file which you downloaded</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/Ves-superstore2/theme_file_decompress.jpg\" style=\"width: 775px; height: 472px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Setp2: </strong>Upload and decompress into webroot folder the file <strong> ves_superstore_media.zip</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/Ves-superstore2/media_file.jpg\" style=\"width: 804px; height: 469px;\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Step3:</strong>&nbsp; Go to your site. It will require you run command code to setup upgrade</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/hBSlEus.png\" style=\"width: 1139px; height: 773px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Step4:</strong>&nbsp; Run there command codes in terminal (SSH)</p>\n<p>\t<strong>php bin/magento setup:upgrade --keep-generated</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong>php bin/magento setup:static-content:deploy</strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/B1oJvB0.png\" style=\"width: 1147px; height: 785px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Step5:</strong>&nbsp; Choose default theme</p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Go to admin &gt; Stores &gt; Configuration &gt; General &gt; Design &gt; Choose design theme &quot;Venustheme - Fasony&quot;</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/63gZDyW.png\" style=\"width: 1592px; height: 548px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&gt;&gt; Go to admin &gt; Stores &gt; Configuration &gt; General &gt; Web &gt; Default Pages &gt; Choose default cms homepage</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/A6LDPVp.png\" style=\"width: 1604px; height: 728px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Theme Configuration","id": "theme_configuration","content": "<h2>\n\t1.Fasony - Theme Source code</h2>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/ym0hus5.png\" style=\"width: 664px; height: 553px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>1.1 theme.xml</strong></p>\n<pre class=\"plain\">\n&lt;theme xmlns:xsi=&quot;http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance&quot; xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation=&quot;urn:magento:framework:Config/etc/theme.xsd&quot;&gt;\n     &lt;title&gt;Venustheme - Fasony&lt;/title&gt; &lt;!-- your theme&#39;s name --&gt;\n     &lt;parent&gt;Magento/blank&lt;/parent&gt; &lt;!-- the parent theme, in case your theme inherits from an existing theme --&gt;\n     &lt;media&gt;\n         &lt;preview_image&gt;media/preview.jpg&lt;/preview_image&gt; &lt;!-- the path to your theme&#39;s preview image --&gt;\n     &lt;/media&gt;\n &lt;/theme&gt;</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>1.2 compser.json</strong></p>\n<pre class=\"plain\">\n{\n    &quot;name&quot;: &quot;magento/theme-frontend-fasony&quot;,\n    &quot;description&quot;: &quot;N/A&quot;,\n    &quot;require&quot;: {\n        &quot;php&quot;: &quot;~5.5.0|~5.6.0|~7.0.0&quot;,\n        &quot;magento/theme-frontend-blank&quot;: &quot;100.0.*&quot;,\n        &quot;magento/framework&quot;: &quot;100.0.*&quot;\n    },\n    &quot;type&quot;: &quot;magento2-theme&quot;,\n    &quot;version&quot;: &quot;100.0.1&quot;,\n    &quot;license&quot;: [\n        &quot;OSL-3.0&quot;,\n        &quot;AFL-3.0&quot;\n    ],\n    &quot;autoload&quot;: {\n        &quot;files&quot;: [\n            &quot;registration.php&quot;\n        ]\n    }\n}</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>1.3 registration.php</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/M9ejJ3W.png\" style=\"width: 864px; height: 360px;\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>1.4 etc/view.xml : Config all size of theme image<br>\n\t<br>\n\t<br>\n\tFor example:</strong></p>\n<pre class=\"plain\">\n&lt;image id=&quot;bundled_product_customization_page&quot; type=&quot;thumbnail&quot;&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;width&gt;100&lt;/width&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;height&gt;117&lt;/height&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;/image&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;image id=&quot;cart_cross_sell_products&quot; type=&quot;thumbnail&quot;&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;width&gt;279&lt;/width&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;height&gt;325&lt;/height&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;/image&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;image id=&quot;cart_page_product_thumbnail&quot; type=&quot;small_image&quot;&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;width&gt;100&lt;/width&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;height&gt;117&lt;/height&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;/image&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;image id=&quot;category_page_grid&quot; type=&quot;small_image&quot;&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;width&gt;279&lt;/width&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;height&gt;325&lt;/height&gt;\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &lt;/image&gt;</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\t2. Backend config</h2>\n<h3>\n\tConfigure theme:</h3>\n<p>\tIn order to configure theme, please go to magento admin panel &gt;&gt; store &gt;&gt; configuration</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i100.photobucket.com/albums/m11/lieult84/Ves%20Yume/theme4_zpswjctketg.png\" style=\"width: 716px; height: 856px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;Then open&nbsp;<strong>Design tab</strong>&nbsp;&gt;&gt; choose&nbsp;<strong>Ves Fasony </strong>in the&quot; Design Theme&quot; options</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/63gZDyW.png\" style=\"width: 1592px; height: 548px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Config Homepage default:</strong></p>\n<p>\t<strong><img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/A6LDPVp.png\"></strong></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\tFrom the left menu select <strong>Content &gt; Pages</strong>. Here you can find all the store pages. <strong>Home page, About Us and 404 Not Found...</strong> should already be available, so you don&#39;t need to add them. You only need to update the pages HTML and XML content. Open any of them in order to get the access to the content.</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/5S59L7z.png\" style=\"width: 1041px; height: 695px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Home page configuration","id": "home_page_configuration","content": "<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i634.photobucket.com/albums/uu64/bhmedia_lieu/ves_fasony/homepage.jpg\" style=\"width: 535px; Menu Top:</h2>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/bNZ3tcn.png\" style=\"width: 725px; height: 57px;\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t<strong>Admin / Content / Block / Fasony - MenuTop:</strong></p>\n<pre class=\"html\">\n&lt;div class=&quot;ves-megamenu-custom&quot;&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;ves-megamenu ves-horizontal&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;nav-item level0&quot;&gt;&lt;a class=&quot; nav-anchor&quot; href=&quot;{{store url=&#39;#&#39;}}&quot; target=&quot;_self&quot;&gt; &lt;span&gt;Desktops&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;nav-item level0&quot;&gt;&lt;a class=&quot; nav-anchor&quot; href=&quot;{{store url=&#39;#&#39;}}&quot; target=&quot;_self&quot;&gt; &lt;span&gt;Shop&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;nav-item level0&quot;&gt;&lt;a class=&quot; nav-anchor&quot; href=&quot;{{store url=&#39;#&#39;}}&quot; target=&quot;_self&quot;&gt; &lt;span&gt;Pages&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;nav-item level0&quot;&gt;&lt;a class=&quot; nav-anchor&quot; href=&quot;{{store url=&#39;#&#39;}}&quot; target=&quot;_self&quot;&gt; &lt;span&gt;Featureds&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;nav-item level0&quot;&gt;&lt;a class=&quot; nav-anchor&quot; href=&quot;{{store url=&#39;#&#39;}}&quot; target=&quot;_self&quot;&gt; &lt;span&gt;Blog&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n&lt;/ul&gt;\n&lt;/div&gt;</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\tCall static-block on this file :<strong> app\design\frontend\Venustheme\fasony\Magento_Theme\layout\default.xml</strong></p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/8RC8ffq.png\"></p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Categories & Product Page","id": "categories_product_page","content": "<p>\t<strong>1 . Choose layout for categories page:</strong></p>\n<p>\tGo to Admin -&gt; Products -&gt; Categories -&gt; edit Categories item -&gt; Custom Design -&gt; choose Page Layout your want to use:</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/ad8EcjI.png\" style=\"width: 1764px; height: 806px;\"></p>\n<p>\t<strong>2 . Choose layout for product detail page:</strong></p>\n<p>\tGo to Admin -&gt; Products -&gt; Catalog-&gt; edit Categories item -&gt; Custom Design -&gt; choose Page Layout your want to use:</p>\n<p>\t<img alt=\"\" src=\"http://i.imgur.com/OUEl8mP.png\" style=\"width: 1492px; height: 911px;\"></p>\n"},{"title": "Developer Guide","id": "developer_guide","content": "<h2>\n\tHow to install and configure Grunt in Magento 2</h2>\n<p>\tAlthough Magento 2 introduces built-in Grunt tasks, there are still several steps you have to perform before using it:</p>\n<p>\tFirst of all, you should install<strong> <a href=\"https://nodejs.org/en/\">Node.js.</a></strong></p>\n<p>\tThen, it&rsquo;s necessary to install Grunt CLI tool globally:</p>\n<div class=\"crayon-pre\" style=\"font-size: 12px !important; line-height: 15px !important;\">\n\t<pre class=\"js\" id=\"crayon-5638ba698dcb7208769194-1\">\n<span class=\"crayon-e\">npm </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">install</span><span class=\"crayon-h\"> </span><span class=\"crayon-o\">-</span><span class=\"crayon-i\">g</span><span class=\"crayon-h\"> </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">grunt</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">-</span><span class=\"crayon-v\">cli</span></pre>\n</div>\n<p>\tas well as Grunt in your Magento 2 directory:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\ncd &lt;your_Magento_instance_directory&gt;\nnpm install grunt --save-dev\n</pre>\n<p>\tNow, it&rsquo;s time to work with the <b><i>node.js</i></b> project dependency for your Magento 2 instance: you have to refresh (or install) it:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\ncd &lt;your_Magento_instance_directory&gt;\nnpm install\nnpm update</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\t<br>\n\tMagento 2 Grunt Commands</h2>\n<p>\tUse the Grunt commands described below to perform different customization tasks in your Magento 2 project. All commands should be run from the installation directory of Magento 2.</p>\n<ul>\t<li>\t\t<strong>grunt clean:&lt;theme name&gt;</strong>. This command removes static files related to your theme in both pub/static and var directories.</li>\n\t<li>\t\t<strong>grunt exec:&lt;theme name&gt;</strong>. This one republishes source files symlinks to pub/static/frontend/&lt;Vendor&gt;/&lt;theme&gt;/&lt;locale&gt;.</li>\n\t<li>\t\t<strong>grunt less:&lt;theme name&gt; </strong>should be used to compile .css files using symlinks from the aforementioned directory.</li>\n\t<li>\t\t<strong>grunt watch</strong>. This command is designed for the LiveReload extension. It tracks changes in the source files, recompiles .css files, and reloads browser pages.<br>\n\t\t&nbsp;</li>\n</ul>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tHow to clean CSS cache in Magento 2</h2>\n<p>\tTo clean CSS cache or refresh less files, use the following command:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\nphp bin/magento setup:static-content:deploy</pre>\n<p>\tAlternatively, you can use dev mode during development:</p>\n<p style=\"margin-left: 40px;\">\n\tClear the var/generation and var/di directories</p>\n<p style=\"margin-left: 40px;\">\n\tRun the mode:</p>\n<div class=\"crayon-pre\" style=\"font-size: 12px !important; line-height: 15px !important;\">\n\t<pre class=\"js\" id=\"crayon-5638ba698dcee633704234-1\">\n<span class=\"crayon-e\">php </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">bin</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">/</span><span class=\"crayon-e\">magento </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">setup</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">:</span><span class=\"crayon-v\">mode</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">:</span><span class=\"crayon-e\">set </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">developer</span></pre>\n</div>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tHow to add new theme name to run Grunt in Magento 2?</h2>\n<p>\tThe next step requires adding your theme to Grunt configuration. In the <strong>dev=&gt; tools =&gt; grunt =&gt; configs =&gt; theme.js</strong> file add new config for theme Yume</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\nluma: {\n        area: &#39;frontend&#39;,\n        name: &#39;Magento/luma&#39;,\n        locale: &#39;en_US&#39;,\n        files: [\n            &#39;css/styles-m&#39;,\n            &#39;css/styles-l&#39;\n        ],\n        dsl: &#39;less&#39;\n    },\n    superstore: {//your theme name\n        area: &#39;frontend&#39;,\n        name: &#39;Venustheme/fasony&#39;,//theme path\n        locale: &#39;en_US&#39;,\n        files: [\n            &#39;css/styles-m&#39;,\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &#39;css/styles-l&#39;,\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &#39;css/bootstrap/bootstrap&#39;,\n&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &#39;css/bootstrap/theme&#39;,\n        ],\n        dsl: &#39;less&#39;\n    },</pre>\n<h2>\n\t&nbsp;</h2>\n<h2>\n\tMagento 2 LESS compilation with Grunt on Windows</h2>\n<p>\tFirst of all, you should install Grunt in in your Magento 2 project. Then, it i necessary to:<br>\n\t<br>\n\tAdd a theme to Grunt configuration. Add your theme to module.exports in <strong>dev=&gt; tools =&gt; grunt =&gt; configs =&gt; theme.js </strong></p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\nsuperstore: {\n        area: &#39;frontend&#39;,\n        name: &#39;Venustheme/fasony&#39;,\n        locale: &#39;en_US&#39;,\n        files: [\n            &#39;css/styles-m&#39;,//path to root source file\n            &#39;css/styles-l&#39;,//path to root source file\n            &#39;css/bootstrap/bootstrap&#39;,//path to root source file\n            &#39;css/bootstrap/theme&#39;,//path to root source file\n        ],\n        dsl: &#39;less&#39;\n    },</pre>\n<p>\t<br>\n\tRun CMD as an admin and go to the root directory of your Magento 2 project via cmd<br>\n\tEnter the following command :</p>\n<div class=\"crayon-pre\" style=\"font-size: 12px !important; line-height: 15px !important;\">\n\t<pre class=\"js\" id=\"crayon-5638ba698dd04256467904-1\">\n<span class=\"crayon-e\">grunt </span><span class=\"crayon-v\">exec</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">:</span><span class=\"crayon-o\">&lt;</span><span class=\"crayon-v\">theme</span><span class=\"crayon-o\"> name&gt;</span></pre>\n</div>\n<pre class=\"js\">\ngrunt less:&lt;theme name&gt;</pre>\n<p>\t...And this one:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\ngrunt watch</pre>\n<p>\tChanges your Less file.<br>\n\tRefresh browser. As mentioned above, it is possible to see all changes without refreshing your browser with the aid of the LiveReload extension.<br>\n\t<br>\n\tPatches for Master branch users are listed in the full article about Magento 2 Grunt. For further information, follow the this</p>\n<ol>\n\t<li>\t\tAdd your theme to Grunt configuration. To do this, in the <strong>dev=&gt; tools =&gt; grunt =&gt; configs =&gt; theme.js </strong> file, add your theme to <strong>module.export</strong></li>\n\t<li>\t\tRun cmd as Administrator</li>\n\t<li>\t\tGo to your root directory of your Project using cmd</li>\n\t<li>\t\tRun below command :-\n\t\t<ul>\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t<strong>grunt exec:&lt;theme name&gt;</strong></li>\n\t\t</ul>\n\t</li>\n\t<li>\t\tafter that Run this command :-\n\t\t<ul>\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\t<strong>grunt watch</strong></li>\n\t\t</ul>\n\t</li>\n\t<li>\t\tNow make changes in your Less file.\n\t\t<ul>\t\t\t<li>\t\t\t\texample: <strong>_theme.less</strong></li>\n\t\t</ul>\n\t</li>\n\t<li>\t\tRefresh browser and see the changes.</li>\n</ol>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2>\n\tHow to Update Magento 2</h2>\n<p>\tThis part of the Magento 2 tutorial describes how to update the software without reinstalling it. Being crucial for getting all the latest code changes, the procedure requires doing everything in an development environment.</p>\n<p>\tThis step requires diffing and merging c<strong>omposer.json.old</strong> with <strong>composer.json</strong> installed with the Magento 2 software. These actions are possible with the aid of the following command:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\ncomposer update</pre>\n<p>\tAfter manipulations with <strong>composer.json</strong>, you should update the Magento 2 database. Run the command below:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\nphp bin/magento setup:upgrade</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">\n\tHow to get Reindexing</h2>\n<p>\tUse the following command to perform reindexing:</p>\n<pre class=\"js\">\nphp bin/magento indexer:reindex</pre>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n<p>\t&nbsp;</p>\n"},{"title": "Information","id": "information","content": "<h1>\n\tThank
